entries.meaning: The negation of the sentence \(P\).

entries.read: f from n-bit strings to bits
entries.meaning: A Boolean function: one yes/no answer for each \(n\)-bit input string.
Exclusive OR: one when exactly one input is one. It is addition modulo two.
AND of two bits: one only when both are one.
Landauer’s minimum heat for erasing one equally likely bit at temperature \(T\).
The rule that sends each input \(x\) to the output \(y\).
The reversible oracle for \(f\): it keeps \(x\) and XORs \(f(x)\) into a target, \(U_f\ket{x,y}=\ket{x,y\oplus f(x)}\).
Add the following term for every value of \(j\).
Conditional probability: the chance of next state \(j\) when the current state is \(i\).

entries.read: r e to the i phi
entries.meaning: An amplitude with magnitude \(r\ge0\) and phase \(\phi\). Its outcome probability is \(r^2\).
The imaginary unit, with \(i^2=-1\).
The complex conjugate: for \(z=a+ib\), \(z^*=a-ib\).
The size of a complex number. \(|z|^2=z^*z\) turns an amplitude into a probability weight.
Turns a row into a column or a column into a row; \((a,b)^T\) is a column vector.
The column vector of a state, named \(\psi\). The brackets name a vector; they are not an operation.
The computational basis: \(\ket0=(1,0)^T\) and \(\ket1=(0,1)^T\).
The conjugate-transpose row of \(\ket\phi\).
The inner product \(\sum_j\phi_j^*\psi_j\): the transition amplitude with final state \(\phi\) on the left and initial state \(\psi\) on the right.
The length of a vector, \(\sqrt{\braket vv}\). A state vector has norm one.
The joint state of two systems, also written \(\ket{ab}\). Dimensions multiply.
The entangled state \((\ket{00}+\ket{11})/\sqrt2\).
All \(n\) qubits in state zero.
The matrix that leaves every vector unchanged.
The adjoint: the conjugate transpose \((A^*)^T\), defined by \(\braket\phi{A\psi}=\braket{A^\dagger\phi}\psi\).
The diagonal matrix with entries \(a\) and \(b\).
The projector onto the unit vector \(\ket e\).
The projector for measurement outcome \(j\). The Born rule gives \(p(j)=\|P_j\ket\psi\|^2\).
The bit flip, phase flip, and Hadamard gates.
\(n\) copies combined by the tensor product. \(H^{\otimes n}\) applies \(H\) to each of \(n\) qubits; \(\ket\psi^{\otimes2}\) is two copies of \(\ket\psi\).
A density matrix, describing a preparation that need not be pure.
The sum of diagonal entries. With \(\rho\), the Born rule is \(p(j)=\operatorname{tr}(P_j\rho)\).

entries.read: minus one to the f of x
entries.meaning: The sign a phase oracle attaches to input \(x\): \(+1\) when \(f(x)=0\), \(-1\) when \(f(x)=1\).

entries.read: sine squared theta equals M over N
entries.meaning: Defines the search angle \(\theta\) for \(M\) marked items among \(N\).

entries.read: big O of g of n
entries.meaning: An eventual upper bound up to a constant factor.

entries.read: big omega of g of n
entries.meaning: An eventual lower bound up to a constant factor.

entries.read: big theta of g of n
entries.meaning: Both an upper and a lower bound: growth exactly like \(g(n)\) up to constants.
Every problem in the first class is also in the second.

entries.read: lambda x dot t, applied to u
entries.meaning: In lambda calculus, a function with parameter \(x\) and body \(t\), applied to \(u\).
